entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: aggregation input is not a known exp-histogram dropping shape: %v
entries.rationale: this lowerer's sole caller, lowerExpHistogramDroppingShape, only invokes it after aggregationOverExpHistogramDroppingShape's own isExpHistogramDroppingShape(agg.Expr, s, ctx) predicate has already proven agg.Expr matches one of lowerExpHistogramDroppingShape's own recognized shapes — isExpHistogramDroppingShape and lowerExpHistogramDroppingShape dispatch the identical ordered set of recognizers, so a positive predicate guarantees the immediately-following lowering call also matches.

guard: past returning if err := validateHistogramDroppingAggregationParam(agg, s, ctx); err != nil
